milestone: Spearman correlation MalPhylo sim vs MalTree embedding sim (H2)
spearman_p_value_note: INVALID: treats 21 dependent pairs (all C(7,2) of 7 objects) as independent; reported only for transparency, superseded by mantel_exact below

mantel_exact.test: Mantel permutation test on 7x7 similarity matrices (Spearman matrix correlation), all 5040 permutations enumerated for an exact p-value
mantel_exact.rationale: Correct test for correlated similarity matrices; respects pairwise non-independence and resolves pseudoreplication inconsistency with the family-level resampling design

limitations: Only 7 paired samples (21 pairs) — far below the recommended ≥100 pairs for a reliable correlation
Cross-corpus overlap is only 28 SHA256s between MalwareBazaar (9961) and MalTree (102322), of which 7 have MalPhylo features available
If ρ is insignificant, this may be due to small sample size rather than a true lack of correlation
Recommendation for manuscript: acquire a larger overlapping corpus or run a same-corpus H2 test on MalTree's own raw samples (if available)
interpretation: Spearman ρ=0.6519 (p=0.0014) on 21 pairs. PASS: ρ ≥ ρ_min (0.30) — interpretable features correlate with ML embeddings.
